tools.askDescription: Send one carefully prepared request to the configured Zuko larger-model workflow. Before calling, independently confirm: Are you sure your search is correct? Run now? A confirmed call consumes the hard cooldown even if the downstream request fails.
tools.checkDescription: Check whether RGD1 changed after the larger-model request. If it changed, run that stored rgd command once in the configured shell and return its output. If it did not change, report that the result is not ready.

messages.confirmationPrompt: Are you sure your search is correct? Run now?
messages.waiting: the larger-model result is not ready; RGD1 has not changed
messages.unavailable: this tool is unavailable at the moment
